method.moves: ATM IV from closing quote mids, 1 SD = IV x sqrt(T); bands = close +/- k SD (no skew)
method.gex: Cboe OI x Black-Scholes gamma (Cboe IV) x 100 x S^2 x 0.01, calls +, puts -, US$ per 1% move
method.flip: strike where cumulative net GEX (from the lowest strike up) is lowest

source: Cboe delayed option quotes (end of day), OCC cleared volume; derived figures only
disclaimer: Informational only; delayed data; not investment advice.
